content.title: What time does Justin Bieber perform at Coachella 2026?
content.text: Karol G (Kevin Mazur/Getty Images for Coachella)The schedule and stage times for the second weekend of the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival have been revealed. Weekend two takes place April 17-19 in Indio, California. Scroll down to see the full breakdown.Unlike last Saturday, Jack White will not be a special guest; instead, the surprise Saturday-afternoon addition is none other than Kacey Musgraves. She announced her Mojave stage booking on her Instagram story, in between a series of posts about UFO sightings.Headliners Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, and Karol G are returning for a second weekend. They and Musgraves joins the likes of Alex G, PinkPantheress, Iggy Pop, Geese, Little Simz, Devo, and Blood Orange. Last weekend, Anyma’s Friday-night set on the main stage, right after Sabrina Carpenter, was moved to Sunday at the Do LaB due to inclement weather. This week, he is due to make his main stage debut at midnight on Friday.Weekend two kicks off at 1 p.m. Pacific on Friday, April 17.Weekend 2 Schedule(All times p.m. unless otherwise noted, listed in
